doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Still playing with Gerald Wilson and Clayton-Hamilton
summary: Young says his hearing is weaker but he plays with Wilson and the Clayton-Hamilton band, and he and Wilson came to California within a short time of each other.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: You‘re still working with your buddy Gerald Wilson.
Oh yeah, I still work with Gerald, me and Gerald‘s very close man. I still work with Gerald. Gerald and I, we were like brothers really because we go back to…
So far back, back to Chick Carter.
That‘s right, we go back to when we were coming out of our teens.
And you‘re both here in Los Angeles.
Yeah, well see, funny thing. When we left Jimmie Lunceford…
Gerald came to California, it wasn‘t too long before I came to California.
